subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Attack programs apply 1 Strengthened and deal 2% Max HP recoil damage. Fire attacks deal up to 50% more damage, scaled by how much of your max HP is missing.
subjects.archetypeSummary: UNBOUND_KERNEL berserker - attacks self-buff and cost 2% maxHP recoil. Ticket 26 shipped it at 0.00 and ticket 28 found the reason: the AI, not the deck.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Whenever Fenrir applies the Burn status to any unit - including himself - he gains a stack of Sharp.
subjects.archetypeSummary: CINDER_WALL_OS Burn engine - every Burn he applies, INCLUDING to himself, feeds Sharp. Holds ash_communion, the registry's loudest card redline.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Whenever Kraken's side draws a card outside the draw phase, apply 1 Dazed to a random enemy.
subjects.archetypeSummary: ABYSSAL_INK draw engine - four draw cards feed the ink, ink_stream is the clock.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Water cards that cost 2 or more Energy deal 30% more damage.
subjects.archetypeSummary: TIDAL_CRUSH ramp into 3-energy Water payoffs.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: At the end of your turn, store unused Energy as Energized. At the start of your next turn, take 1% Max HP damage per hoarded point (min 1) as the hoard is cashed in.
subjects.archetypeSummary: HOARD_PROTOCOL - bank unused Energy 1:1 against an HP tax, then dump it into deep_vein. Four 0-costs so the AI never has to choose between acting and banking.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: At the start of Fafnir's turn, he gains 2 Strengthened for each different debuff on him, then each of those debuffs loses 1 stack.
subjects.archetypeSummary: CORRUPTED_GOLD_OS - self-inflicted Poison feeds 2 Strengthened per distinct debuff at turn start. Poison rather than Weakened because Poison has no duality partner to annihilate against.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Whenever an allied Mingming takes damage from an enemy attack, Sköll gains 1 stack of Strengthened.
subjects.archetypeSummary: TREACHERY_KERNEL glass cannon - Strength on incoming damage. The kernel OVER-feeds: peak Strength measures 13.7 stacks in 3.4-turn games against a 12.5 cap, so the ramp is pinned by turn 2.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Skoll's attacks deal +15% damage per stack of Strength she holds (max 5 stacks).
subjects.archetypeSummary: SOLAR_FLARE_OS - Fire cards against a heavily Burned target refund Energy.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Each turn, the 5th Water card you play draws 1 card.
subjects.archetypeSummary: OUROBOROS_LOOP - an all-Water zero-cost storm where every third Water card refunds Energy and a card; serpents_coil is the cards-played payoff. Nothing here may be None-tier or the loop stops counting.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Jörmungandr's venom coats his fangs: his attacks deal +1 damage per Poison stack on the target.
subjects.archetypeSummary: VENOM_TRENCH_OS - tanky poison attrition on the roster's largest HP pool, into a contagion double-up.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Playing a non-Attack card that applies a status primes Gullinbursti: his next Attack deals 3 additional power for each stack of Sharp he holds. Any other card spends the charge.
subjects.archetypeSummary: UNSTOPPABLE_MASS prime-and-spike - a status card primes, and the next Attack lands with +3 power per stack of Sharp. Ticket 52 gave the prime that Sharp scaling; before it, v1 generated Sharp it had no way to spend.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Earth Attack cards deal additional damage for each stack of Sharp Gullinbursti holds, but the ram blunts its own edge: he takes 1 Dazed at the start of each of his turns.
subjects.archetypeSummary: KINETIC_RAM_OS multi-hit - Sharp adds flat damage to every hit, so three-hit cards triple it. The ram blunts its own edge: 1 self-Dazed a turn, and Dazed is Sharp's duality partner.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Whenever you voluntarily discard a card from your hand, deal moderate Air damage to a random enemy.
subjects.archetypeSummary: GALE_FORCE_OS - voluntary discards become Air damage. Tempest-heavy, which is why its dead-card ratio needs reading against shed-by-effect rather than rot.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: The first time you cycle through your entire deck and shuffle your discard pile, permanently gain +1 max Energy for the rest of the battle.
subjects.archetypeSummary: UPDRAFT_KERNEL - permanent scaling on each full cycle of the deck. Carries a standing 48% dead-card reading that predates ticket 46 and nobody has diagnosed.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Whenever you play a card that costs 0 Energy, Sleipnir gains 2 stacks of Strengthened.
subjects.archetypeSummary: MOMENTUM_DRIVE - the same 0-cost fuel ratatoskr_v1 runs, but into raw Strength rather than card volume.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Whenever Sleipnir plays an Air Attack card, generate a 0-cost Hoof Strike token card in your hand.
subjects.archetypeSummary: WAR_STEED_OS - Air attacks generate 0-cost Hoof Strike tokens, so the deck widens as it goes.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: 0-cost programs heal all allies for 2.5% of their max HP.
subjects.archetypeSummary: GOSSIP_NODE card spam. Five 0-costs, each doubled by echo_chamber tokens; seed_bomb is the payoff. shrug_off is its only answer to a status clock.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Whenever Ratatoskr plays a 0-cost card at an enemy, he applies 1 stack of Dazed to the target.
subjects.archetypeSummary: INSTIGATOR_OS Dazed stacking. Same fuel, opposite payoff: slander reads raw Dazed stacks and ignores the +-25% cap.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Whenever Huldra applies a buff to herself or an ally, she mirrors it by applying 1 stack of Weakened to a random enemy.
subjects.archetypeSummary: ALLURE_PROXY mirrors buffs as a hex; hexbloom converts the Weakened pile into Poison at x2 without consuming it.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Huldra starts every battle with a massive, temporary shield.
subjects.archetypeSummary: BARK_SHIELD_OS shield wall on a Poison clock - she wins inside the shield's life.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: At the start of Ymir's turn, it gains 4 Bark Shield.
subjects.archetypeSummary: GLACIER_HEART_SYS - the wall IS the weapon. 5 BarkShield at turn start, cast off as damage by avalanche without consuming it.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Jötunn cannot play more than 1 card per turn, but all Ice cards deal 25% more base damage.
subjects.archetypeSummary: GLACIAL_PACE - two big cards a turn, no 0-costs and no neutral tier, since a None card gets neither STAB nor the Ice bonus.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Draugr can act while Asleep. Whenever it wakes from Asleep or is revived, it gains 1 Energized and draws a card.
subjects.archetypeSummary: PERMAFROST_WAKE - sleeps on purpose. Asleep is a stance he pays a card to enter; nightmare and barrow_rot cash it, and the wake pays 1 Energized and a card.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Enemies afflicted with 2 or more different negative statuses deal 20% less damage to the Draugr.
subjects.archetypeSummary: GRAVE_CHILL_OS - cheap debuff variety, cashed by rimebreaker, which scales on the same distinct-debuff count the firmware gates on.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: At the end of Valkyrie's turn, play a random card from her discard pile for free.
subjects.archetypeSummary: VALHALLA_UPLINK - applying any positive status pays out. PLACEHOLDER deck, untuned; do not read its numbers as balance signal.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Whenever Valkyrie's discard pile is shuffled back into her deck, she attacks a random enemy with 12 power of Light damage and heals herself with 12 power. Once per turn.
subjects.archetypeSummary: CRUSADER_KERNEL - Light attacks scale on the NUMBER of distinct positive statuses she holds, not their stacks. PLACEHOLDER deck, untuned.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Whenever healing applied to Audhumbla exceeds her maximum HP, permanently increase her maximum Energy pool by 1. Once per turn.
subjects.archetypeSummary: GENESIS_FIRMWARE - every third Heal or Skill permanently raises her Energy ceiling. PLACEHOLDER deck, untuned.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: 50% of the printed heal power of every heal Audhumbla casts is also dealt as Light damage to a random enemy.
subjects.archetypeSummary: NOURISH_ROUTINE - overheal converts into Light damage, so healing past full is offence. PLACEHOLDER deck, untuned.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: The element Hel casts sets her stance at the end of the action. Dark Stance: +30% damage dealt. Light Stance: -30% damage taken.
subjects.archetypeSummary: TWILIGHT_CADENCE sets her stance from the element she casts, at end of action.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Hel's Dark spells cost 6% of her max HP per Energy of their printed cost instead of Energy. She can spend at most 25% of her max HP this way each turn.
subjects.archetypeSummary: UNDERWORLD_GATEWAY zeroes her Energy cost and taxes every card at 5% maxHP - the only Mingming who casts 3-energy cards freely, with her own hand as her clock.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Poison afflicting Níðhöggr's enemies does not lose stacks at the end of their turn (a final single stack still fades).
subjects.archetypeSummary: ROOT_CORRUPTION turns poison into a permanent RATE; wither_feast cashes the pile.

subjects.osFirmwareDescription: Whenever any Mingming drops below half of its maximum HP, Nidhoggr smells blood: gain 1 Energy and draw a card. Healing above half re-arms the scent.
subjects.archetypeSummary: BLOOD_SCENT pays 1 Energy and a card per below-half crossing.
